instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Event venue and catering company managing a conference center and 3 satellite event spaces. Hosting 500+ corporate events and weddings annually. Looking to implement end-to-end event management software covering CRM, floor plan design, menu customization, and day-of operations coordination. We operate across multiple geographies and business units with a matrix organizational structure. A centralized digital transformation office coordinates innovation initiatives, but business unit autonomy means adoption varies significantly.
answers.pastInitiatives: We installed IoT sensors on 40% of our production equipment to monitor utilization and predict failures. The pilot showed a 15% reduction in unplanned downtime on instrumented machines. We now have a business case approved for full fleet rollout, but procurement and integration with our legacy maintenance system are proving more complex than anticipated.
answers.strategicGoals: Our board has set an ambitious revenue target of reaching €50M ARR within 5 years from our current base. This requires us to expand our addressable market, potentially pivot pricing models from one-time to recurring revenue, and build a repeatable enterprise sales motion. We need to identify the highest-leverage growth levers without overextending our cash runway.
answers.additionalContext: The company faces intense competition from both traditional venues and specialized SaaS providers in the event tech space. Rapid adoption of new technologies is crucial to maintain a competitive edge in delivering high-touch, scalable experiences.
answers.teamSize: We have a corporate innovation division with 50+ staff spanning research scientists, engineers, designers, and strategy professionals. The division manages a portfolio of 15 active innovation projects at various maturity stages, from early-stage research collaborations with universities to near-commercialization products. Annual innovation budget is managed through a formal portfolio governance process with stage-gate funding decisions.

opportunities.title: AI-Driven Dynamic Pricing and Inventory Optimization
opportunities.rationale: Implementing machine learning to predict demand fluctuations across different event types and time slots could significantly increase revenue per event by optimizing pricing strategies. This leverages existing data from CRM and past sales cycles.

first_actions: Conduct a feasibility study on integrating current booking data with ML prediction models.
Allocate 5% of the innovation budget to pilot a dynamic pricing module in one key business unit.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Increase average event profitability by 8% within 12 months.
milestones: Month 3: Model training complete for core business units.
Month 9: Pilot rollout in two satellite venues.

opportunities.title: Hyper-Personalized, Self-Service Event Lifecycle Platform
opportunities.rationale: Develop a radical shift from current end-to-end software to an 'Autonomous Experience Engine' that uses generative AI and predictive analytics to handle everything from personalized guest journey mapping to real-time operational adjustments without human intervention.

first_actions: Establish a dedicated cross-functional task force focused purely on the autonomous platform concept.
Create a minimum viable product (MVP) for automated menu and floor plan generation.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
resources_needed: Investment in Generative AI tooling licenses
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce average end-to-end operational coordination time by 40% through automation.
milestones: Month 6: Successful internal MVP testing with zero manual intervention required.
Year 2: Launch of the core self-service platform.

next_steps.action: Formalize the strategy for recurring revenue adoption and pricing model pivots.
Initiate a dedicated project team to scope and develop the MVP for AI-driven dynamic pricing.

key_weaknesses: Inconsistent organizational adoption of new technologies due to decentralized business unit autonomy.
High dependence on legacy systems making integration and scaling complex and costly.
Limited formal structure for ideation outside the centralized office, leading to bottlenecks in early-stage research.
Current budget allocation heavily weighted toward infrastructure/maintenance rather than market-facing product innovation.
